properties.name: v0.29.0 cut, 2026-08-12. The design HOLDS: reflow2.toml's version string moved 0.28.0 -> 0.29.0 because a release was cut. The design meaning of a cut lives in rel:v0290 and epoch:v0290, never in a version string, so nothing in the design changed.
